config.description: Only writer of sensor.ls_overrides (Variables+History). Scripts, automations, dashboards and remotes fire an `ls_override` event: {op: set, records: [{kind, target, value}], via?, who?} | {op: clear, keys: [...], via?} | {op: clear_all, via?}. Records are keyed '<kind>:<target>' (block:<area>, light:<entity>) with when/who/via; who defaults to the user behind the event. Queued, so writes never interleave. Newest wins: setting block:<area> drops older lamp holds (light:*) in that area (lamps outside the room scopes count as house); setting a mode (Sara Mode, common areas only) drops every lamp hold outside areas labelled Private Room. A newer lamp hold still beats an older block for that one lamp.
